sources.title: MahjongAI/COMMANDS.md at master · Skianyan/MahjongAI · GitHub
sources.snippet: Trains two models and merges them into one checkpoint with model_type: policy_with_discard_head: Global policy — standard action vocabulary policy network. Discard specialist — 34-type tile classifier used only on discard-only turns (no calls, riichi, or win available). At inference, CompositePolicyAgent routes discard-only turns to the specialist and other turns to the global policy.
